title: द्विभाषिकता तथा बहुभाषिकताको सापेक्षतामा बहुभाषिक शिक्षा
nepali: आर्थिक, सामाजिक, राजनैतिक, शैक्षिक र ऐतिहासिक पक्षका दृष्टिले बहुभाषिकतालाई विश्वव्यापी साझा अवधारणाका रूपमा लिइन्छ । प्रस्तुत लेखमा द्विभाषिकता तथा बहुभाषिकताको परिचय, परिभाषा र यसका प्रकार साथै बहुभाषिक शिक्षाको अवधारणालाई चर्चा गरिएको छ । गुणात्मक प्रकृतिको प्रस्तुत लेखमा पुस्तकालयका माध्यमका आधारमा तथ्याङ्क सङ्कलन गरिएको छ । सङ्कलित तथ्याङ्कलाई वर्णनात्मक तरिकाले विभिन्न शीर्षक र उपशीर्षकमा विश्लेषण गरिएको छ । द्विभाषिक र बहुभाषिक शब्दको प्रयोग एकभन्दा बढी भाषा प्रयोगका सन्दर्भमा गरिन्छ । यसका साथै बहुभाषिक, द्विभाषिक र त्रैभाषिक शिक्षालाई बहुभाषिक शिक्षाको अवधारणाभित्र समेटिएको छ । बहुभाषिक, बहुजातीय र बहुसांस्कृतिक समाजमा विभिन्न गतिविधि सञ्चालनका क्रममा तथा आपसी सम्प्रेषणका लागि प्रयोग हुने भाषाको अवस्था द्विभाषिकता तथा बहुभाषिकताको हो । बहुभाषिकताले कम्तीमा दुई भाषामा सम्प्रेषणको सामथ्र्यताको अपेक्षा गर्ने हुँदा बहुभाषिक शिक्षाको आवश्यकता ज्वलन्त बनेको देखिन्छ । बहुजातीय समाजमा विभिन्न गतिविधि सञ्चालन, एवम् आपसी सम्प्रेषणका दुई भाषाको प्रयोग हुने अवस्था द्विभाषिकता तथा बहुभाषिकता भएकाले यसको महŒवपूर्ण आधार बहुभाषिक शिक्षा हो । बहुभाषिक शिक्षाले घरको भाषा र विद्यालयको भाषालाई जोडी विस्तृत सञ्चारको भाषालाई शिक्षाको पहुँचमा पु¥याउने उद्देश्य राखेको देखिन्छ । नेपालको सन्दर्भमा भने बहुभाषामा शिक्षा, मातृभाषामा शिक्षा वा मातृभाषाको शिक्षा भन्ने उद्देश्य स्पष्ट भएर मात्र बहुभाषिक शिक्षा नीति बनाएर कार्यान्वयन गर्न सकेमा प्रभावकारी हुने बुझाइलाई लेखको निष्कर्षको रूपमा प्रस्तुत गरिएको छ ।
american_english:
From economic, social, political, educational, and historical perspectives, multilingualism is regarded as a universal shared concept.
In this article, an introduction to bilingualism and multilingualism, their definitions and types, along with the concept of multilingual education, have been discussed.
This qualitative article has collected data on the basis of library sources.
The collected data have been analyzed descriptively under various headings and subheadings.
The terms 'bilingual' and 'multilingual' are used in the context of the use of more than one language.
Furthermore, multilingual, bilingual, and trilingual education have been subsumed within the concept of multilingual education.
In a multilingual, multi-ethnic, and multicultural society, the state of the languages used in carrying out various activities and for mutual communication is that of bilingualism and multilingualism.
Since multilingualism entails the ability to communicate in at least two languages, the need for multilingual education has become acute.
In a multi-ethnic society, the situation in which two languages are used for carrying out various activities and for mutual communication constitutes bilingualism and multilingualism, so the important foundation of this is multilingual education.
Multilingual education appears to aim at linking the language of the home and the language of the school, thereby bringing the language of wider communication within the reach of education.
In the context of Nepal, however, the understanding that multilingual education will be effective only if a multilingual education policy is formulated and implemented after the objectives—education in multiple languages, education in the mother tongue, or education of the mother tongue—have been clarified has been presented as the conclusion of the article.

informal_english: Looking at it from economic, social, political, educational and historical angles, multilingualism is taken as a universal shared idea. In this piece, I introduce bilingualism and multilingualism, define them and their types, and talk through the idea of multilingual education. This is a qualitative piece, and the data were gathered from library sources. The data collected were then analysed descriptively under various headings and subheadings. The words 'bilingual' and 'multilingual' are used when more than one language is in play. On top of that, multilingual, bilingual and trilingual education are all folded into the notion of multilingual education. In a society that's multilingual, multi-ethnic and multicultural, the state of the languages used for getting things done and for communicating with one another is bilingualism and multilingualism. Because multilingualism means being able to communicate in at least two languages, the need for multilingual education has become pressing. In a multi-ethnic society, the situation where two languages are used for getting things done and for communicating with one another is bilingualism and multilingualism, so multilingual education is the important foundation of it. Multilingual education seems to aim at joining the language of the home with the language of the school, bringing the language of wider communication within reach of education. In Nepal's context, though, the article's conclusion is that multilingual education will only work if a multilingual education policy is drawn up and put into practice once the aims—education in several languages, education in the mother tongue, or education of the mother tongue—have been made clear.
